verses.en: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Naou 6aua ina ua latou fai mai ia te au, Tatou te o i le fale o le ALII.

verses.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ierusalema e, e tutu o matou vae i ou faitotoa.

verses.en: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.sm: Uaatiina ae Ierusalema pei o le aai ua fesootai faatasi.

verses.en: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.sm: Eo aeaio itu aiga, o itu aiga lava o le ALII, o le tulafono lea ia Isaraelu, ina ia vivii atu ai i le suafa o le ALII.

verses.en: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.sm: Auā ua tu ai nofoālii e faamasino ai, o nofoālii o le aiga o Tavita.

verses.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.sm: Ato: atu outou ina ia manuia Ierusalema; e manuia i latou o e alolofa ia te oe.

verses.en: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.sm: Iaiaile manuia i totonu O ou pa, o le manuia i totonu o ou maota.

verses.en: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.sm: Ona o oʻu uso ma au aumea mamae, ou te faapea atu ai lava, la ia te oe le manuia.

verses.en: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.sm: Ona ole fale o le Au lo tatou Atua, ou te saili ai le manuia mo oe.
